title: The comparison diagram between adic completion and derived completion for a principal ideal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a commutative diagram with exact rows and columns comparing the f-adic completion of the cohomology of a complex with its derived completion along a principal ideal, and the proof is a 42-line argument. It first builds the inverse system of short exact sequences computing the cohomology of the complexes K_n from the cone construction and passes to inverse limits using the Mittag-Leffler condition; then it compares the truncation of the complex with the original one to identify the two rows of the diagram, and finally reads the exactness of the columns off the long exact sequence of a principal ideal. The construction of the diagram and the two identifications are all carried out in the source.
